RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, November 12, 2010/Kartika 21, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Human Resource Development; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions—20
13
Storage facility for foodgrains
*61. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of foodgrains damaged
due to scarcity of storage facility during
the current year; and
(b) the details of steps taken or
proposed to be taken by Government to
raise foodgrain storage capacity by
adopting modern techniques for
preservation of foodgrains in the country
in order to avoid their damage?
Recruitment of teachers on contract
basis under SSA
*62. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether State Governments have
been allowed to recruit teachers on contract
basis for primary and secondary levels of
education, out of the funds provided by
the Central Government under Sarva
Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA);
(b) if so, the number of teachers
appointed so far, category-wise, and the
payment for which is due to the State
Government of Assam as envisaged under
this Scheme; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Use of fertilizers
†*63. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
imbalanced use of chemical fertilizers in
the country has caused huge damage to the
agricultural land of the country;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government in
this regard;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

14
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether Government has identified
those regions of the country where
maximum and minimum agricultural land
has been affected; and
(d) if so, the names of those States?
Subsidy to coconut farmers
*64. SHRI S. THANGA VELU: Will the
Minister of  AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
formulate a plan to restructure the Coconut
Development Board (CDB) on the lines of
Rubber Board, since CDB is not functioning
successfully;
(b) whether Government will also
consider to provide subsidy to coconut
farmers to increase the production; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and follow-
up action taken by Government in this
regard?
Revamping of PDS
*65. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
refer to the answer to Unstarred Question
3393 given in the Rajya Sabha on 27 August,
2010 and state:
(a) whether Government has since taken
a decision to revamp the public distribution
system in the country in the light of the
recommendations made by the National
Advisory Council (NAC), recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof vis-a-vis
the recommendations of the Council; and
(c) if no action has so far been taken in
the matter, by when  the same is likely to
be taken?
Syllabus and medium of education in
schools
†*66. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is difference in
syllabus of Government and private
schools;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether children in Government
schools also have the facility of opting for
English language as medium of education;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Demands of Chhattisgarh under PDS
†*67. SHRI SHREEGOPAL  VYAS:
Will the Minister of  CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether demands of Chhattisgarh
for rice and wheat for APL, re-
determination of BPL, foodgrain allocation
for welfare organisations and doing away
with reduction of kerosene have been met;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the future plan in that regard?
Damage to wheat for want of
warehouses
*68. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:

15
(a) the proper storage capacity for
wheat, rice and other cereals available in
different States, particularly in States with
large procurement;
(b) the quantity of wheat that got
damaged in different States for want of
proper warehousing; and
(c) the manner in which the damaged
wheat is proposed to be disposed of?
Vacant posts in Railways
*69. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of posts of running
staffers comprising loco drivers, assistant
loco drivers and motor-men, along with
those of top posts in the Indian Railways
lying vacant as on 31 March, 2010,
category-wise; and
(b) the steps taken to fill up these vacant
posts?
Menace of bogus ration cards
*70. SHRI Y .S. CHOWDARY: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
magnitude of the problem due to bogus
ration cards;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the action plan adopted to weed out
bogus ration cards throughout the country
and the prescribed time limit for such
exercise;
(d) the details of bogus ration cards
identified and weeded out during the last
five years, State-wise;
(e) the details of financial loss caused to
the nation due to these bogus cards; and
(f) whether Government intends to bring
in any legislation to deal with this menace
firmly?
Higher acreage for better production
*71. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI : Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that higher acreage
results in better production of various food-
items;
(b) if so, the details thereof in the last
five years and  demand of various food
items in each State including in Andhra
Pradesh (A.P.); and
(c) the action plan prepared in this
regard for the current year to boost the
production of each food-item?
Report of IFPRI on poverty in the
country
*72. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
International Food Policy Research
Institute (IFPRI) has portrayed an alarming
situation of poverty in the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a large
number of people above the poverty line
are also falling below the poverty line;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the reasons for apathy of
Government to universal PDS in such a
situation?

16
More express trains via Kanpur,
Farrukhabad, Kasganj and Mathura
*73. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether steps have been taken/are
being taken to run more express and long
distance trains via Kanpur, Farrukhabad,
Kasganj and Mathura;
(b) if so, the plans in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that the officers
of North Central Railway (NCR) and North
Eastern Railway (NER) have held meetings
in this regard; and
(d) if so, the decisions taken therein and
the steps taken to implement the same at
the earliest?
Launching of new railway card
†*74. SHRI Y .P. TRIVEDI: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Railways are going to launch
a new railway card in place of Go-Mumbai
card after its discontinuation;
(b) if so, which one and by when it will
be launched; and
(c) the details thereof?
Compilation of wait-listed tickets
under HOR/VIP quota
*75. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
HOR/VIP requisitions received and wait-
listed tickets confirmed against these are
not compiled by divisional/zonal
commercial offices and particularly by head
office in the pretext of voluminous work
involved;
(b) whether Government is aware that
there is a standing order in this regard;
(c) whether railway officials, in
connivance with middlemen, confirm wait-
listed tickets not as per the warrant of
entitlement and urgency but according to
their discretion; and
(d) whether random raids will be
conducted by independent agencies like
CBI so that corrupt officials may be
apprehended/probed and fresh order for
compilation will be issued?
Suicide by farmers
†*76. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of  AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the reasons behind rising graph of
suicides by farmers of Vidarbha;
(b) the details of steps taken by
Government to prevent the farmers of the
country from committing suicide after loss
of crops and to solve their problems;
(c) whether any case of suicide
committed by farmers due to delay and
difficulty in Government-aid and
lackadaisical attitude of bureaucrats has
come to light; and
(d) the number of farmers who
committed suicide in the country due to
debt and loss in crops during the last five
years?
Credit facility to agriculturists
*77. SHRI SHYAMAL CHAKRA-
BORTY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 40 per cent
of agriculturists are not interested in
agriculture despite increase in credit to
agriculturists during the period 2000-2007;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

17
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether these credits are meant for
the benefit of agro-industries; and
(c) if not, the details of the amount given
as credit to agriculture producers and their
number?
Monitoring agency for implementation
of RTE Act
†*78. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a National Advisory
Council has been constituted to monitor
the implementation of Right to Education
Act, 2009;
(b) if so, the composition and terms of
reference of the Advisory Council;
(c) whether States have adequate
resources for implementation of Right to
Education Act;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the manner in which financial
assistance for implementing the Right to
Education Act is proposed to be given by
Government to States including
Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh?
Nutrient Based Subsidy for
Fertilizers
*79. SHRI M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for the Ministry
opposing the Finance Ministry's fertilizer
subsidy proposal of Nutrient Based
Subsidy (NBS);
(b) whether the Ministry feels that the
proposed NBS would affect the small and
marginal farmers; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Extension of Rashtriya Swasthya
Bima Yojana
*80. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to refer to the
answer to Unstarred Question 3473 given
in the Rajya Sabha on 27 August, 2010 and
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that under clause
57 of Railway Budget speech 2010-11, it
was proposed to extend Rashtriya
Swasthya Bima Yojana to all licensed
porters, vendors and hawkers; and
(b) if so, under what circumstances the
scheme is being extended to porters only?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 6th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Kartika 15, 1932 (Saka)

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)

Human Resource Development : 62, 66, 78,
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises :—
